Latin word

nunc

adverb

now, at present; now, these days

In this lexicon

  • now

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 4.25–26: sed haec prius fuēre: nunc …; Liv. 21.54.2: nunc corpora cūrāre tempus est; Traupman 88

  • today

    also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.57 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 88

    but all that was before: now it is laid up and grows old in peaceCatull. 4.25–26
